name: Nanai
source:
She was the right-hand woman and mistress of the "King of Thieves," but since two years ago, she has been hiding out in a mobile harem, escaping the eyes of the authorities and turning herself into a dancer.
She has had both of her legs replaced with artificial limbs due to the effects of the fear disease.

She's the protagonist of the third chapter.
